trigger: After the selected regional jobs close, at least one planned 22000/30000 reconstruction is unavailable because training or extraction failed.
selection_rule: The same fixed 8000 checkpoint for all three regions. No last-available or quality-based checkpoint selection; missing prefix is unavailable.
validation: Complete iteration8000 receipt, checkpoint and PLY hashes, count and finite values
Recorded 8000 trace and post-optimizer save provenance

comparison.primary: Existing ALS-initialized Anchor8000 versus SfM-initialized refinement8000

limitations: A valid 8000 prefix does not establish 22000/30000 completion or final convergence.
Initialization, supervision, protection membership and schedules still differ.
Surface export may fail independently of checkpoint availability.
